Garlicky Caesar Salad Wraps
By: Kristi Rimkus
Published: Tuesday, December 8, 2009 - 11:27pm

Ingredients




4 cups lettuce, romaine, chopped
1 can cannelini beans, rinsed and drained
2 large roma tomato, seeded and chopped
1/2 cup light Caesar salad dressing
8 tablespoons goat cheese, shredded
4 ea FlatOut Flat Bread

Preparation

1 Combine ingredients and serve with FlatOut flat bread.

About


Are you looking for a satisfying lunch? Something different than the usual sandwich, soup or salad? Try this Caesar wrap I made with Flatout flatbread.
